about: Single source for the 90 s hackathon cut: scene windows, burned-in captions (cap), voice-over text (vo, defaults to cap) and the footage placement. build.mjs --cut hackathon, make-voice.py --cut hackathon, stage.html and hackathon.test.mjs all read this file. Spec and claims ledger: docs/demo/hackathon-90s.md. Times are video seconds.

en.cap: Find a format. Plan the outline. Gather sources. Fix the style.
Then explain all of it to your AI. Again.
One sentence. Three documents. Three websites.
In Arise Browser, an agent works on each one.
But first, it asks Document Memory.
Three agents. Three windows. At the same time.
Each asks for the format, the sources and the rules.
It returns structure, citations, and open questions.
en.vo: It returns the structure, the citations, and a flag on anything still unconfirmed.

en.cap: So they write instead of guessing.
en.vo: So they write instead of guessing. The Slides window is a real run, fast-forwarded.

en.cap: Docs, deck and post. Ready for your review.
en.vo: A one-pager, a ten-slide deck, and a blog post, ready for your review.

en.cap: Templates and sources live in a shared library.
en.vo: Templates, references and rules live in a shared library, with author, version and license attached.

en.cap: Copy one, and your agent starts from good work.
en.vo: Copy one, and your agent starts from someone else's good work.

en.cap: Ten minutes saved, a thousand reuses: about 167 hours.
en.vo: Say each reuse saves ten minutes. A thousand reuses: about 167 hours. A what-if, not a measurement.

en.cap: Share the memory. Save the time.
en.vo: My Document Memory. Share the memory. Save the time.

footage.note: Files are relative to demo/out/. speed is the playback factor in the video; 'from'/'to' are video seconds. Product clips are scripted clicks on the real app (capture-product.mjs); the Slides clip is a real agent run from the WAM project (prep-slides.mjs).
